name: Thaumaturgy (Path of the Blood's Curse) — Basic — Ravages of the Beast

system.description: Against any Kindred within her line of sight, the thaumaturge who wins a Mental Challenge forces the target to immediately test for frenzy of a type appropriate to the situation. Kindred with Instinct rather than Self-Control will always frenzy if this power succeeds against them. This path may only be learned by Kindred of 10th generation or weaker, and its powers only function against vampires of equal or better generation. It retests with the Occult Ability.
